### Education

* BSc, computer engineering, Universidade Estadual de Campinas

André Selva is a leading member of BCG X in Brazil. X is Boston Consulting Group's tech build and design unit. André is also a member of BCG's Industrial Goods and Energy practices, with significant experience in material and process industries, especially steel and agribusiness. He has particular expertise in topics related to the application of advanced analytics and data science in supply chain, operations, and sales and pricing in B2B.

Among his many client engagements, André recently helped a steel producer develop advanced analytics solutions to optimize its supply chain distribution and production planning; worked with a large steel producer to transform its pricing function, including the development of analytical solutions supporting the granular price definition; and supported the digital twin development for the industrial process of an industrial player, substantially increasing throughput of bottleneck assets.

Before joining BCG, André was a Consultant at Monitor Group.
